title: Percents
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review
about: Teacher-verified mastery check. Written separately from the practice generators: different wordings, word problems, and an 'is this right?' item. Each item is worth 1 point. 'math' is the calculation behind the item, used only by the test that checks the answer key.
directions: Show your work. Write every fraction in simplest form. Percent means 'out of 100'.

items.prompt: Write 45% as a fraction in simplest form.
Of the 60 seniors at a school, 15% play on a sports team. How many seniors is that?
A basketball player made 18 of her 24 free throws this season. What percent of her free throws did she make?
Dev says 25% of 80 is 80 ÷ 25 = 3.2. Is he right? Explain, and give the correct answer.
items.answer: 20 (No: 25% means 25 out of 100, which is 1/4, and 1/4 of 80 is 20)

items.prompt: Write 64% as a fraction in simplest form.
Your phone plan has 20 GB of data each month. So far you have used 30% of it. How many GB have you used?
A survey says 0.6 of students have a part-time job. Rico says that is 6% of students. Is he right? Explain, and write 0.6 as a percent.
